tt_statement: No PUBLICATION_SUBJECT_ATTESTATION in the repository named an R5P commit.

subject.carried_by: the commit that adds the sidecar (see git log -1 -- .hgk/ao/pub/PUBLICATION_SUBJECT_ATTESTATION_R5P_POSTCHALLENGE.json)
subject.convention: same as the R5 pin: the sidecar is attested against the commit that WROTE it and is carried by the next commit; PUBLISHED_COMMIT (R5) = f4f0a02 is carried by 5094939 in exactly this way

artifact.sha256_note: canonical value is the LF blob that git stores (.gitattributes: * text=auto eol=lf); the first writing of the file had CRLF line endings in the worktree, which would have made a worktree-only hash impossible to reproduce from a clone. The worktree file was normalized to LF, so worktree == committed blob == clone, and the tool's --verify still exits 0.

verification.covers: subject commit/tree, tool product_digest, tool manifest_digest, payload tamper-evidence

checker_identity.provider: OpenAI OAuth (sealed VERIFY front door, container, read-only product)
checker_identity.why_substituted: tools/publication_attestation.py fills checker_identity from the tracked .hgk/ao/FROZEN_CANDIDATE_R3.json, so every newly built sidecar is stamped with the R3 checker (INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTANCE_OFFICER_R3 / GLM-5.3-Flash). Committing that for an R5P subject would be a misattribution. The R3 file was not rewritten; the substitution is done by an explicit, committed round script and the tool's own --verify is re-run and still exits 0.

disclosures: TWO DIGEST DEFINITIONS: this sidecar's product_digest (53456af2..., the tool's definition over PRODUCT_PREFIXES) is NOT the round's bound digest (6120cf37..., bound_digest.py over PRODUCT_ROOTS). They are different rules over different path sets. The external challenge's C8 found exactly this class of ambiguity; no attempt is made to equate them here.

PROJECTION COVERAGE GAP: tools/build_publication_manifest.py --check --current exits 1 with CURRENT_TREE_UNCOVERED for tests/test_git_object_reader.py (present at the baseline, so pre-existing), tests/test_doctor_schema_truth.py and tests/test_tqaep_design_positive.py (added by this round). Regenerating PUBLICATION_PROJECTION_MANIFEST.json with --write against the R5P subject (1916 entries) does NOT clear it, because dispositions come from .hgk/artifacts/evidence_manifest.json, which does not list those paths. That regeneration was therefore REVERTED and the R5 version of the projection manifest is intact. Fixing this is a separate publish step (extend the evidence manifest + reseal -> which in turn rebinds this sidecar's source_manifest_seal), recorded as TT-R5P-13.

The R5 pin constants (PUBLISHED_COMMIT/PUBLISHED_TREE/PUBLISHED_REF) were NOT changed; only an auditable comment block was added, following the file's own convention of keeping superseded pins in comments.

The known pre-existing test failure tests/test_publication_projection...test_attestation_build_then_verify_exits_zero is unaffected by this work: it uses tool defaults, where build resolves PUBLISHED_REF (local r5-s4-candidate = 5094939) but verify expects PUBLISHED_COMMIT (f4f0a02). It is ref-dependent and SKIPS from a clone or worktree (verified: baseline worktree reports OK (skipped=1)). Recorded as TT-R5P-14.
